# Coverage ratchet baseline (Annex A6). Monotonic floors -- these numbers may
# only go UP. Raise them in the same commit that adds coverage; never lower them
# without an explicit, reviewed justification in the commit message.
#
# Why these metrics: the A7 dry-run proved the host suites are blind to upstream
# changes in the replaced owners, so the real M10 protection is the C-vs-Zig
# differential (A5) and the full-core parity harnesses, NOT raw line coverage of
# vendored deps. The ratchet therefore guards the count of owner functions under
# differential and the number of full-core parity harnesses -- the gains that
# actually catch a bad re-port -- so a future change cannot quietly delete them.
#
# (When A0's owner-object instrumentation lands -- see report-zig-coverage.sh --
# add a zig_src covered-line floor here too.)

# Owner functions under the C-vs-Zig differential (extract_oracle.sh FUNCS).
differential_functions=5

# Full-core parity/differential harness steps (saveload, keyboard_entry,
# charstring_diff, distribution_parity, ...) that link the real core.
fullcore_harness_steps=4
